It seems the function signature is huge due to many optional parameters. But we only need to supply required ones: api_key, resource, comment_json. Others can be omitted or set to defaults.

Thus we should call the function with:

{
    api_key: "XYZ789",
    resource: "10.0.0.1",
    comment_json: '{"type":"comment","attributes":{"text":"Needs review #unsure"}}'
}

We don't need to specify comment_type etc because they are optional. The comment_json already includes type and attributes. So we can just pass that.
